name: Liupanshui, Guizhou
tagline: China's Cool Capital — A 19°C Summer Escape
intro: Known as 'China's Cool Capital' for its year-round comfortable climate (summer averages just 19°C), Liupanshui offers the vast Wumeng grassland, alpine skiing in winter and golden ginkgo villages in autumn. Cool air makes for an especially pleasant recovery.

highlights.name: Wumeng Grassland (乌蒙大草原)
highlights.description: Rolling alpine meadows with wind turbines, sea-of-clouds sunrises and grazing herds — a Tibetan-plateau feel in Guizhou.

highlights.name: Alpine Ski Resort
highlights.description: One of southern China's rare ski areas — hit the slopes in winter without the cold of the north.

highlights.name: Tuole Ancient Ginkgo Village
highlights.description: In late autumn, 1,200 ancient ginkgo trees turn a golden sea — a surreal, photogenic wonder.

highlights.name: Cool-Climate Living
highlights.description: Year-round mild weather — ideal if you prefer healing in comfort, not humidity.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Liupanshui
itinerary.description: Transfer in; enjoy the cool evening.

itinerary.title: Treatment & Rest
itinerary.description: Consultation and first session; rest in cool comfort.

itinerary.title: Wumeng Grassland
itinerary.description: Full day on the alpine meadows; sunrise optional.

medical.advantages: Liupanshui's partner clinic provides the group's care standards in the most climate-comfortable city in Guizhou — a smart choice for summer travellers.
